paragraphs: GoodVision sells traffic analysis software to transportation professionals, who use it to collect, analyze and act on traffic data taken from video footage or live camera streams. Its main platform, Video Insights, extracts data from videos in place of manual collection and uses AI to analyze traffic and automate model calibration.

A second product works on live feeds rather than uploads, analysing camera streams on the fly and passing traffic data to third-party systems such as traffic management systems and controllers. The incident detection module recognises user-defined traffic events, flags them and reports them to traffic management centre controllers. At intersections and roundabouts it counts volumes and derives parameters such as speed, gaps between vehicles, dwell time and passage time. Finished reports can be edited, regenerated and exported in Excel, CSV or custom formats.

The company describes the same monitoring applied to bridges and tunnels, where the goal is to prevent congestion and catch accidents early. Alongside direct sales, GoodVision runs a partner program and says it is seeking global distribution and service partners.

quote.text: GoodVision Video Insights is an AI-driven platform for advanced traffic analytics
